answer.reason: The verses tell two things that happened at Marah: its waters were bitter, and they were made sweet.

clauses.english: had bitter waters that Israel could not drink
clauses.quote: they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter

clauses.english: had its waters made sweet when Moses cast in a tree the LORD showed him
clauses.quote: the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet
